options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: value
options.description: Initial value; also the value restored by reset().

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name, set on the hidden input that carries the canonical value.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Supplementary hint; never replaces the label.

options.name: required
options.description: Empty value is invalid; shows the required indicator.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disables the input and steppers; the value is not submitted.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Value is focusable and submitted but not editable or steppable.

options.name: min
options.description: Minimum value; also the step base and the Home target.

options.name: max
options.description: Maximum value; End goes to the largest on-grid value <= max.

options.name: step
options.description: Increment and step-validation grid (base min ?? 0). Default 0.01 for percent style. null: any value, increments of 1.

options.name: format
options.type: { minimumFractionDigits?: number; maximumFractionDigits?: number; useGrouping?: boolean; style?: 'decimal' | 'percent' | 'currency' | 'unit'; currency?: string; unit?: string }
options.description: Display format (Intl.NumberFormat subset). maximumFractionDigits also rounds the value on commit.

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

options.name: icons
options.type: Partial<{ error: IconRef; increment: IconRef; decrement: IconRef }>

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

options.name: showSteppers
options.description: Render increase/decrease buttons (pointer affordance; keyboard users use the arrow keys).

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: formInput
properties.description: Hidden input carrying the canonical value and name.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current parsed value; null when empty or unparseable.

properties.name: text
properties.description: Text in the input (raw while typing, formatted after commit).

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message }; computed on every change.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Value differs from the initial value, or the text is unparseable.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatic value; reformats the display (no events); clears an external custom error.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, registration, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-input
events.detail: { value: number | null; text: string; validity: FieldValidity }
events.description: User typed, or stepped (keyboard or stepper buttons, since 0.9.0); value is the parse of the raw text.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: User committed a changed value (blur, Enter, arrow/page/Home/End keys, or a stepper button).
